title: Smoke Aerosol Measurement Experiment-Reflight
objectives: Determine the sizes and size distributions of smoke particles in microgravity and relate them to how the smoke is generated and transported, while improving particle-shape data and reducing measurement uncertainty. It repeats SAME because the SAME samples came back from space contaminated with foreign particles, which limited their use.
approach: The SAME hardware was reused with improved sampling and diagnostic units. Five materials (Teflon, Kapton, cotton lampwick, silicone rubber and Pyrell) were heated below their ignition temperature, and the particles were measured with aerosol instruments and collected for electron microscopy.
